blockers.what: A right-click on open ground can pick an enemy Wick that is 45-70 m away and far off the screen, so the hero runs off to attack it. This is the owner's complaint that the hero 'runs around on its own'.
evidence: farpick probe, RIFT, ground click by the outer Needle at (61.38,51.58): sent attack target 2567, a greatwick at (67.1,96.8), 45.6 m away, whose feet project to screen (34869,256891) px; at (63.32,47.27) sent attack 5633, a shieldwick at (111.2,96.5), 68.7 m away. 10 of 70 samples picked an off-screen Wick at y ~96 (bottom lane).
wall sweep, head: 5 of 45 RIFT wall clicks by needle_outer picked an off-screen minion and chased it 2.7-33.7 m (ulkro 33.7 m, ervet 32.8, tunlan 28.1, dunsom 17.9, lisvel 2.7)
wall sweep, base 098ac7436: 6 of 27 did the same (lisvel 32.3 and 31.8 m, tunlan 32.4 and 15.9, ervet 20.5 and 6.3). Same 3 fighters at head: 3 of 27.

grid probe (1010 points every ~7 s, 1:00-9:00, hero beside each allied structure): an earlier head run hit 154 of 1010 points at 3:39 (needle_bell spot, greatwick 846 at (77.9,99.9)); the reruns found 0 of 66 samples (head) and 0 of 65 (base). It is intermittent and depends on where Wicks stand relative to the camera.
blockers.likelyCause: render/pick.ts pickUnit culls a unit only when its feet project behind the camera (_p.z > 1). A unit just in front of the camera plane but far outside the frustum projects to huge screen values, and its head and ring points can flip, so its pick box covers much of the screen. Not changed by 4c0a3e365: the pick.ts diff against 098ac7436 is the 4 px head trim only.

measures.rebind: The Settings row 'Attack in place (hold, then left-click)' shows L Shift; it arms, rebinds to V with a toast, then to L Ctrl and back to V. The settings help lists the row. In the match, the hint reads 'Hold V and left-click to shoot in place toward the cursor without moving'. V+left sent attackAt, and Shift+left after the rebind sent nothing.

verdict: Round 3 controls work live. HOLD-DITHER does not reproduce: 0 of 49 held moves through packed fights had 3 or more reversals, and the worst ended 0.56 m short. Right-click moves end within 2 m (74/74). The ervet wall repro walks round to 0.94 m from the click. Plain, Shift+right and A-click picked the meant minion in a clump 78/78, and Z never targets a minion. Shift+left attacks in place in every direction with 0 drift on all 5 fighters, and the rebind row and help text work. It still fails on FAR-PICK: an empty-ground right-click near the RIFT outer Needle can pick a Wick 45-70 m off screen and send the hero running 17-34 m. This is the owner's 'runs around on its own'. It is pre-existing (base 6/27 wall clicks, head 5/45), so the round is safe to ship: no player-visible measure is worse than 098ac7436, and idle drift, Shift+left and clump picks are better.
